title: France - 2026.08.05
notes: France faces a compounding challenge: a deficit running at roughly twice the European Union's legal ceiling and a parliament too fragmented to agree on how to fix it. Debt has climbed above 115 percent of GDP, interest costs are rising, and the government has so far failed to secure a stable majority for a durable budget. The result is an anxious standoff that carries real consequences for markets, public services, and France's standing with its EU partners.
